name: Lead The Charge
description:
Once per round: For the next round, you take –2 Defense and all allies within medium range get +1d to their attack rolls.

Describe how you charge ahead.

improvements.name: Break Their Line
improvements.description: You may spend 1 additional MP to take an additional -3 Defense and give all allies within medium range an additional +1d to their attack rolls for the next round.
